title: Wizard's Farm
description: A 1.20.1 minecraft modpack that aims to blend the powers of create and the magic of Botania and others.
body:
Have YOU ever wanted to live the peaceful life of a forest wizard? Perhaps, the life of adventure that comes with being a warlock? Want to train your own dragon? Or perhaps, the ideal life, is to make a potion factory and sell all your potent brews to all the lands? Well, good news... NOW IS YOUR CHANCE! 

Wizard's farm aims to give you, the player, an experience I often find lacking from other magic-centered modpacks. I've always wanted to cultivate a huge household, with automated elements, while also practicing the magical arts- but they've always had a strong side and a weak side. 

By combining Create with Botania, as well as Iron's spells and spellbooks, and Farmer's delight with various additions and compatibilities, I personally feel like I have made the perfect combination of cozy, adventure, survival, combat, and automation. 

Have fun! Community page may open soon.

Disclaimer: This modpack is a side-project whilst I attend uni. I'm not a developer, and if you change anything in the modpack, I may not know how exactly to give help or advice. However, I am open to discussion, just note my responses will be slow. There is no questbook, just have fun.

Reupload of my initial project because I was running into issues upadting versions on the old version.

All mod content belongs to their respective owners. Wizard's Farm may be recompiled as **AS LONG AS THE ORIGINAL CONTENT IS LINKED IN THE COMPILATION'S DESCRIPTION.**
